questions.question: A regular polygon has 2n sides. What is the angle made between two adjacent sides (in degrees)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interior angle of regular polygon = [(n−2)/n] × 180°

Here sides = 2n

⇒ Angle = [(2n − 2)/(2n)] × 180

= [(n − 1)/n] × 180

= 180 − 180/n = (1 - (1)/(n)) times 180^circ 

**∴ Answer = (1 - (1)/(n)) times 180^circ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of sides = 2n

**Formula used:**

Interior angle = [(Number of sides − 2)/Number of sides] × 180°

**Calculation:**

⇒ Interior angle = [(2n − 2)/(2n)] × 180°

⇒ = [(n − 1)/n] × 180°

⇒ = 180° − (180/n) = (1 - (1)/(n)) times 180^circ 

**∴ The correct answer is (1 - (1)/(n)) times 180^circ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interior Angle Formula

[(n − 2)/n] × 180°

Regular Polygon

All sides and angles are equal

Exterior Angle

= 360° / number of sides

Quick Tip

Interior angle = 180° − exterior angle

questions.question: In a test, B got 50 marks while A got 75 marks, out of 100 maximum marks. What percentage of A's marks was B's marks? (Round off the answer to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:

Required % = (B ÷ A) × 100

= (50 ÷ 75) × 100

= (2/3) × 100 = 66.67%

**∴ Answer = 66.67%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

B = 50, A = 75

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Part ÷ Whole) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Percentage = (50 ÷ 75) × 100

⇒ = 0.6666... × 100

⇒ = 66.67% (rounded to two decimal places)

**∴ The correct answer is 66.67%.**

questions.question: If the mean proportional of P and 150 is 120, then find the value of P.5767
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional of two numbers a and b is √(a × b).

By squaring the given mean proportional, we can quickly find the unknown value.

P = (Mean Proportional)² ÷ Given Number

P = 120² ÷ 150 = 14400 ÷ 150 = 96

**∴ The correct answer is 96.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

One number = P

Second number = 150

Mean proportional = 120

**Formula Used:**

If x is the mean proportional of a and b, then a : x :: x : b, which means the product of extremes equals the product of means (x² = a × b).

questions.question: What price should Anjali mark on a shirt which cost her ₹7,000, so as to gain 17% after allowing successive discounts of 35% and 30%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required SP for 17% gain = 7000 × 1.17 = 8190

Successive discounts ⇒ net factor = 0.65 × 0.70 = 0.455

MP × 0.455 = 8190

⇒ MP = 8190 ÷ 0.455 = 18000

**∴ Answer = ₹18000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP = 7000; Gain = 17%; Discounts = 35%, 30%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + gain%); SP = MP × (1 − d₁)(1 − d₂)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = 7000 × 117/100 = 8190

⇒ Let MP = x

⇒ SP = x × (0.65 × 0.70)

⇒ 8190 = x × 0.455

⇒ x = 8190 ÷ 0.455

⇒ x = 18000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹18000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

Multiply factors: (1 − d/100)

Profit Formula

SP = CP × (1 + profit%)

Reverse Calculation

MP = SP ÷ (net discount factor)

Key Tip

Always find SP first, then MP

questions.question: The mode of the observations 7, 5, 6, 3, 3, 7, 1, 7, 8, 7, 1, 4, 8, 8 and 4 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode is simply the observation that appears the most number of times in the dataset.

By visually scanning the given numbers, we can see that 7 appears 4 times, which is the highest.

Other numbers appear less frequently (8 appears 3 times, others appear 1 or 2 times).

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The set of observations: 7, 5, 6, 3, 3, 7, 1, 7, 8, 7, 1, 4, 8, 8, 4

**Concept Used:**

The mode is defined as the value that has the maximum frequency in a given set of data.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let us arrange the given observations in ascending order to count their frequencies easily:

⇒ 1, 1, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 7, 7, 7, 7, 8, 8, 8

⇒ Frequency of 1 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 3 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 4 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 5 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 6 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 7 = 4

⇒ Frequency of 8 = 3

⇒ The observation 7 has the maximum frequency of 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

The mean is the average of all the numbers. It is calculated as: Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations.

Median

The median is the exact middle value when a data set is ordered from least to greatest. If the number of observations is even, the median is the average of the two middlemost values.

Empirical Relationship

In a moderately skewed statistical distribution, the relationship between mean, median, and mode is given by the empirical formula: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
</p

questions.question: A total profit of ₹14,200 is to be distributed amongst A, B and C such that A: B = 13 : 9 and B : C = 18 : 11. The share (in) of C in the profit is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A : B = 13 : 9, B : C = 18 : 11

Equalize B ⇒ LCM(9,18) = 18

⇒ A : B = 26 : 18

⇒ B : C = 18 : 11

⇒ A : B : C = 26 : 18 : 11

Total parts = 55

C’s share = (11/55) × 14200 = 2840

**∴ Answer = ₹2840**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A : B = 13 : 9; B : C = 18 : 11; Total = 14200

**Formula used:**

Combine ratios by equalizing common term

**Calculation:**

⇒ A : B = 13 : 9 ⇒ multiply by 2 ⇒ 26 : 18

⇒ B : C = 18 : 11

⇒ A : B : C = 26 : 18 : 11

⇒ Total parts = 26 + 18 + 11 = 55

⇒ C’s share = (11/55) × 14200

⇒ = 2840

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2840.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Combination

Equalize common term before merging ratios

LCM Method

Use LCM to match middle term

Profit Sharing

Share ∝ ratio parts

Quick Tip

Find total parts, then multiply fraction

questions.question: Raman's income is ₹43,000. He saves 26% of his income. If his income increases by 20% and 2 expenditure increases by 40%, then his savings will:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income = 43000 ⇒ Saving = 26% = 11180 ⇒ Expenditure = 31820

New income = 51600; New expenditure = 44548

New saving = 7052

Decrease in saving = 11180 − 7052 = 4128

**∴ Answer = ₹4128 decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income = ₹43000

Savings = 26% of income

Income increases by 20%

Expenditure increases by 40%

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income − Expenditure

New value = Old × (1 ± p/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Original saving = 26% of 43000 = 11180

⇒ Original expenditure = 43000 − 11180 = 31820

⇒ New income = 43000 × 1.20 = 51600

⇒ New expenditure = 31820 × 1.40 = 44548

⇒ New saving = 51600 − 44548 = 7052

⇒ Decrease = 11180 − 7052 = 4128

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4128 decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Relation

Income = Savings + Expenditure

Percentage Change

New value = Old × (1 ± p/100)

Savings Impact

If expenditure increases faster than income, savings decrease

Quick Tip

Always compute new income and expenditure separately before comparing

questions.question: In a farm, there are chickens and rabbits, altogether, there are 20 animals. The total number of legs is 56. How many chickens are there in the farm?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume all are chickens ⇒ legs = 20 × 2 = 40

Extra legs = 56 − 40 = 16

Each rabbit adds 2 extra legs ⇒ rabbits = 16 ÷ 2 = 8

Chickens = 20 − 8 = 12

**∴ Answer = 12 chickens**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total animals = 20

Total legs = 56

Chicken = 2 legs, Rabbit = 4 legs

**Formula used:**

Linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let chickens = x

⇒ Rabbits = 20 − x

⇒ Total legs: 2x + 4(20 − x) = 56

⇒ 2x + 80 − 4x = 56

⇒ 80 − 2x = 56

⇒ 2x = 24

⇒ x = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 chickens.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Assumption Method

Assume all as one type, then adjust using extra values

Linear Equation

Use variables to form and solve equations

Key Idea

Difference in legs helps find number of animals

Quick Tip

Each rabbit contributes 2 extra legs compared to a chicken

questions.question: Find the largest number which divides 62, 134 and 242 to leave the same reminder in each case.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required number = HCF of pairwise differences

⇒ 134 − 62 = 72

⇒ 242 − 134 = 108

⇒ 242 − 62 = 180

HCF(72, 108, 180) = 36

**∴ Answer = 36**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers = 62, 134, 242

Same remainder when divided by a number

**Formula used:**

If a, b, c leave same remainder, then required number = HCF of (a − b), (b − c), (c − a)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 134 − 62 = 72

⇒ 242 − 134 = 108

⇒ 242 − 62 = 180

⇒ HCF of (72, 108, 180)

⇒ HCF(72,108) = 36

⇒ HCF(36,180) = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Key Concept

Same remainder ⇒ differences are divisible by required number

HCF Usage

Take HCF of all pairwise differences

Quick Tip

You can use any two differences, but using all confirms answer

Application

Useful in remainder and divisibility problems

questions.question: A car travels 128 km in the first hour and 146 km in the second hour. What is the average speed (in km / hr ) of the car for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 128 + 146 = 274 km

Total time = 2 hours

Average speed = 274 ÷ 2 = 137 km/hr

**∴ Answer = 137 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance in 1st hour = 128 km

Distance in 2nd hour = 146 km

Total time = 2 hours

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 128 + 146 = 274 km

⇒ Total time = 2 hours

⇒ Average speed = 274 ÷ 2

⇒ = 137 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 137 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

Equal Time Case

When time intervals are equal, average speed = (sum of distances) ÷ total time

Key Insight

Since each segment is 1 hour, just take mean of distances

Quick Tip

If time is equal, average speed = arithmetic mean of speeds

questions.question: A trader marks an item 40% above its cost price and gives a discount of 10%. Find his profit percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let CP = 100

MP = 140

After 10% discount ⇒ SP = 140 × 0.9 = 126

Profit = 126 − 100 = 26

Profit% = 26%

**∴ Answer = 26%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Markup = 40%, Discount = 10%

**Formula used:**

MP = CP × (1 + markup)

SP = MP × (1 − discount)

Profit% = (SP − CP) ÷ CP × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 × 1.40 = 140

⇒ SP = 140 × 0.90 = 126

⇒ Profit = 126 − 100 = 26

⇒ Profit% = (26 ÷ 100) × 100 = 26%

**∴ The correct answer is 26%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

Apply markup and discount multiplicatively

Shortcut Tip

Assume CP = 100 for quick calculations

Profit Concept

Profit is always calculated on CP

Key Insight

Net effect = (1 + markup)(1 − discount)

questions.question: If sec theta + tan theta = 4 + sqrt{15}, { then find the value of } sec theta - tan theta.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (secθ + tanθ)(secθ − tanθ) = 1

⇒ secθ − tanθ = 1 / (4 + √15)

Rationalize ⇒ = (4 − √15) / (16 − 15)

= 4 − √15

**∴ Answer = 4 − √15**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

secθ + tanθ = 4 + √15

**Formula used:**

(secθ + tanθ)(secθ − tanθ) = sec²θ − tan²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ (secθ + tanθ)(secθ − tanθ) = 1

⇒ (4 + √15)(secθ − tanθ) = 1

⇒ secθ − tanθ = 1 / (4 + √15)

⇒ Multiply numerator & denominator by (4 − √15)

⇒ = (4 − √15) / (16 − 15)

⇒ = 4 − √15

**∴ The correct answer is 4 − √15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Key Identity

sec²θ − tan²θ = 1

Important Relation

(secθ + tanθ)(secθ − tanθ) = 1

Rationalization

Multiply by conjugate to simplify surds

Quick Tip

If one expression is given, the other is its reciprocal

questions.question: If 4 lines of a print, in a column of a book, contain 63 words, how many words will a column of 52 lines contain?

Words ∝ Lines

4 lines → 63 words ⇒ 1 line → 63/4 words

52 lines → 52 × (63/4)

= 13 × 63 = 819

**∴ Answer = 819 words**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

4 lines contain 63 words

Required: words in 52 lines

**Formula used:**

Direct proportion ⇒ Words = (New lines × Words₁) ÷ Lines₁

**Calculation:**

⇒ Words = (52 × 63) ÷ 4

⇒ = (13 × 63)

⇒ = 819

**∴ The correct answer is 819 words.**

Direct Proportion

If lines increase, words increase proportionally

questions.question: The ratio of two friends' ages is 4: 5. Together, their ages add up to 36 years. What is the age of the older friend?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total ratio parts = 4 + 5 = 9 parts.

9 parts = 36 years.

1 part = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 years.

Age of older friend (5 parts) = 5 × 4 = 20 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of the ages of two friends = 4 : 5

Sum of their ages = 36 years

 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 4 Parts 5 Parts 
 Total Sum = 9 Parts = 36 Years Younger Friend Older Friend 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the age of the younger friend be 4x and the older friend be 5x.

⇒ Sum of their ages = 4x + 5x = 9x

⇒ Given that the sum of their ages is 36 years.

⇒ 9x = 36

⇒ x = 36 ÷ 9 = 4

⇒ Age of the older friend = 5x = 5 × 4 = 20 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

A ratio compares values, telling us how much of one thing there is compared to another. If a quantity is divided in the ratio a : b, the parts are considered as ax and bx respectively.

Sum of the Parts Method

To find the individual value of a part from the total, use the formula: Part Value = (Individual Ratio ÷ Total Ratio) × Total Value.

Age Problems

The difference between the ages of two people remains constant over time, but their sum and the ratio of their ages change as time passes.

questions.question: If the radius of a cylinder is halved and its height is doubled, then its volume will be ———————.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The volume of a cylinder is proportional to the square of its radius and its height (V ∝ r² × h).

When the radius is halved (1/2) and the height is doubled (2):

Multiplying factor for Volume = (1/2)² × 2 = (1/4) × 2 = 1/2

Since the factor is 1/2, the new volume becomes exactly half of the initial volume.

**∴ The correct answer is Halved.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The radius of the cylinder is halved.

The height of the cylinder is doubled.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

 
 

 
 
• 
 
 r
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 h
 Original
 
 
 

 
 
• 
 
 r/2
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 2h
 New

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the original radius be r and original height be h.

⇒ Original Volume (V₁) = πr²h

⇒ New radius (R) = r/2

⇒ New height (H) = 2h

⇒ New Volume (V₂) = πR²H

⇒ V₂ = π(r/2)² × (2h)

⇒ V₂ = π(r²/4) × 2h

⇒ V₂ = (1/2) × πr²h

⇒ V₂ = V₁ / 2

⇒ Therefore, the new volume becomes half of the original volume.

**∴ The correct answer is Halved.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cone

A cone has exactly one-third the volume of a cylinder that has the same base radius and height. Formula: V = (1/3)πr²h

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a Cylinder

The curved surface area refers only to the area of the outer curved part, excluding the top and bottom circular bases. Formula: CSA = 2πrh

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and both the top and bottom circular bases. Formula: TSA = 2πr(r + h)
</p

questions.question: {If } x + y = 12 { and } xy = 32, { find the value of } x² + y².
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

We need to find two numbers whose sum is 12 and product is 32.

The factor pairs of 32 are (1 × 32), (2 × 16), and (4 × 8).

We can clearly see that 8 and 4 satisfy both given conditions: 8 + 4 = 12 and 8 × 4 = 32.

So, let x = 8 and y = 4.

Now, calculate x² + y² = 8² + 4² = 64 + 16 = 80.

**∴ The correct answer is 80.**

questions.question: If sqrt{72} + sqrt{12} = asqrt{2} + bsqrt{3} , then what is the value of a - b ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Express the surds in their simplest form by factoring out perfect squares:

√72 = √(36 × 2) = 6√2

√12 = √(4 × 3) = 2√3

Compare 6√2 + 2√3 with a√2 + b√3 ⇒ a = 6, b = 2.

Calculate a − b = 6 − 2 = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

√72 + √12 = a√2 + b√3

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorise the numbers inside the square roots to extract perfect squares.

⇒ √(2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3) + √(2 × 2 × 3) = a√2 + b√3

⇒ √(6² × 2) + √(2² × 3) = a√2 + b√3

⇒ 6√2 + 2√3 = a√2 + b√3

⇒ By comparing the corresponding coefficients of the like surds on both sides, we get:

⇒ a = 6 and b = 2

⇒ Now substitute the values into the required expression:

⇒ a − b = 6 − 2

⇒ a − b = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Surds

The multiplication rule of surds √(ab) = √a × √b allows extracting perfect squares from under the radical sign to simplify expressions.

Like and Unlike Surds

Surds having the same irrational factor are called like surds (e.g., 2√3 and 5√3). They can be added or subtracted directly by simply combining their coefficients.

Equating Irrational Expressions

If p√x + q√y = a√x + b√y, where √x and √y are distinctly different prime surds, then we can equate their coefficients directly, meaning p = a and q = b.

questions.question: The monthly incomes of two friends Rupesh and Manjit, are in the ratio 5 : 9, respectively, and each of them saves ₹36,000 every month. If the ratio of their monthly expenditure is 2 : 4, find the monthly income of Rupesh (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income ratio = 5 : 9, Expenditure ratio = 2 : 4 = 1 : 2

Let incomes = 5x, 9x and expenditures = y, 2y

Equal savings ⇒ 5x − y = 9x − 2y

⇒ y = 4x

Saving = 5x − 4x = x = 36000 ⇒ x = 36000

Rupesh’s income = 5x = 180000

**∴ Answer = ₹180000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income ratio = 5 : 9

Expenditure ratio = 2 : 4

Savings = ₹36000 each

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let incomes = 5x and 9x

⇒ Let expenditures = 2y and 4y

⇒ For Rupesh: 5x = 2y + 36000

⇒ For Manjit: 9x = 4y + 36000

⇒ Subtract equations:

⇒ 9x − 5x = 4y − 2y

⇒ 4x = 2y ⇒ y = 2x

⇒ Substitute in first equation:

⇒ 5x = 2(2x) + 36000

⇒ 5x = 4x + 36000

⇒ x = 36000

⇒ Rupesh’s income = 5x = 180000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹180000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Relation

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Ratio Simplification

2 : 4 simplifies to 1 : 2

Equation Method

Form equations using ratios and solve

Key Insight

Equal savings helps eliminate variables

questions.question: Walking at (3)/(4) th of his normal speed from his home, Abhishek is 5 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio = 3/4 ⇒ Time ratio = 4/3

Extra time = (4/3 − 1) = 1/3 of usual time

⇒ (1/3) of usual time = 5 min

⇒ Usual time = 5 × 3 = 15 min

**∴ Answer = 15 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

New speed = (3/4) of normal speed

Extra time = 5 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time ∝ 1/Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let usual time = t

⇒ New time = t × (4/3)

⇒ Extra time = t × (4/3 − 1)

⇒ t × (1/3) = 5

⇒ t = 5 × 3 = 15 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 15 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relation

Time ∝ 1/Speed for fixed distance

Ratio Trick

If speed becomes a/b, time becomes b/a

Extra Time

Extra time = New time − Original time

Quick Tip

Use fractional difference directly to find original time

questions.question:
PQRS is a trapezium with PQ parallel to SR and ∠QRS = 60°. With R as centre and RQ as radius, an arc QAB is drawn which intersects SR in B. A is an arbitrary point on the arc QAB. If PQ = QR = 14 cm and SB = 8 cm, then find the area (in cm², rounded off to the nearest integer) of the region PQABSP.

 ({Take } pi = (22)/(7), { and } sqrt{3} = 1.732)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Base SR = SB + radius BR = 8 + 14 = 22 cm.

Height of trapezium = QR × sin(60°) = 14 × √3/2 = 7√3 cm.

Area of Trapezium = 1/2 × (PQ + SR) × height = 1/2 × (14 + 22) × 7√3 = 126√3 ≈ 218.23 cm².

Area of Sector Q-R-B = (θ/360) × πr² = (60/360) × (22/7) × 14² = 308/3 ≈ 102.67 cm².

Required Area = Area of Trapezium − Area of Sector = 218.23 − 102.67 = 115.56 cm² ≈ 116 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 116 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

PQ = 14 cm, QR = 14 cm, SB = 8 cm, ∠QRS = 60°

Radius of arc RQ = RB = 14 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of Trapezium = 1/2 × (Sum of parallel sides) × height

Area of Sector = (θ/360) × πr²

 
 
 
 
• S P Q R B A 14 cm 14 cm 8 cm 14 cm 
 60° 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SR = SB + BR = 8 + 14 = 22 cm

⇒ Draw perpendicular QN to SR. In ΔQNR, QN (height) = QR × sin(60°)

⇒ Height = 14 × (√3/2) = 7√3 cm

⇒ Area of Trapezium PQRS = 1/2 × (PQ + SR) × Height

⇒ Area of Trapezium = 1/2 × (14 + 22) × 7√3 = 18 × 7 × 1.732 = 126 × 1.732 = 218.232 cm²

⇒ Area of Sector = (60/360) × (22/7) × 14 × 14 = 1/6 × 616 = 102.667 cm²

⇒ Area of Region PQABSP = Area(PQRS) − Area(Sector)

⇒ Area = 218.232 − 102.667 = 115.565 cm²

⇒ Rounding to nearest integer, we get 116 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 116 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Trapezium

The area is computed as 1/2 × (Sum of parallel sides) × perpendicular distance between them.

Area of a Sector

A circular sector with central angle θ and radius r has an area equal to (θ/360°) × πr².

Trigonometry in Geometry

The perpendicular height of a polygon can be directly derived from its slant edge using the sine ratio: Height = Slant Edge × sin(θ).

questions.question: What is the difference between the average of prime numbers between 20 and 40 and the average of multiples of 2 between 10 and 30?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Primes between 20 and 40 ⇒ 23, 29, 31, 37

Average = (23 + 29 + 31 + 37)/4 = 120/4 = 30

Multiples of 2 between 10 and 30 ⇒ 12, 14, ..., 28

AP ⇒ average = (first + last)/2 = (12 + 28)/2 = 20

Difference = 30 − 20 = 10

**∴ Answer = 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Prime numbers between 20 and 40

Multiples of 2 between 10 and 30

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum ÷ Number of terms

For AP: Average = (first + last)/2

**Calculation:**

⇒ Primes: 23, 29, 31, 37

⇒ Average = (23 + 29 + 31 + 37)/4 = 120/4 = 30

⇒ Multiples of 2: 12 to 28

⇒ Average = (12 + 28)/2 = 20

⇒ Difference = 30 − 20 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers

Numbers divisible only by 1 and itself

Arithmetic Progression

Even numbers form an AP

Average Trick

For equally spaced numbers, average = midpoint

Key Insight

Use midpoint formula to save time

questions.question: A can complete one-sixth of a work in 13 days, B can complete 34% of the same work in 17 days, C can complete one-third of the work in 19 days and D can complete three-fourth of the work in 15 days. Who will be able to complete the work first?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find full work time:

A ⇒ (1/6) in 13 days ⇒ full = 13 × 6 = 78 days

B ⇒ 34% = 17/50 ⇒ full = 17 ÷ (17/50) = 50 days

C ⇒ (1/3) in 19 days ⇒ full = 19 × 3 = 57 days

D ⇒ (3/4) in 15 days ⇒ full = 15 × (4/3) = 20 days

Least time = 20 days

**∴ Answer = D**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A does 1/6 in 13 days

B does 34% in 17 days

C does 1/3 in 19 days

D does 3/4 in 15 days

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Time = Total work ÷ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ A’s rate = (1/6)/13 = 1/78 ⇒ time = 78 days

⇒ B’s rate = (34/100)/17 = (17/50)/17 = 1/50 ⇒ time = 50 days

⇒ C’s rate = (1/3)/19 = 1/57 ⇒ time = 57 days

⇒ D’s rate = (3/4)/15 = 1/20 ⇒ time = 20 days

⇒ Minimum time = 20 days

**∴ The correct answer is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency Concept

More efficiency ⇒ less time

Convert % to fraction before solving

Key Idea

Compare total time taken to complete full work

Quick Tip

Convert all to “time for full work” directly

questions.question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 12 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 48 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

P + Q = 1/12, P = 1/48

⇒ Q = 1/12 − 1/48 = 3/48 = 1/16

Q fills full tank in 16 hours

⇒ 1/4 tank time = 16/4 = 4 hours

**∴ Answer = 4 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P + Q can fill tank in 12 hours

P alone can fill tank in 48 hours

**Formula used:**

Work rate = Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ (P + Q)’s rate = 1/12

⇒ P’s rate = 1/48

⇒ Q’s rate = (1/12 − 1/48)

⇒ = (4 − 1)/48 = 3/48 = 1/16

⇒ Time taken by Q for full tank = 16 hours

⇒ Time for 1/4 tank = 16 ÷ 4 = 4 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 4 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work Rate Concept

Rate = 1 / Time

Combined Work

Add individual rates when working together

Partial Work

Time ∝ Work (for constant rate)

Quick Tip

Find full time first, then scale for fraction

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹2,000 at 15% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the interest rate into fraction: 15% = 15/100 = 3/20.

The multiplying factor for 1 year of compound interest is 1 + 3/20 = 23/20.

Amount after 2 years = Principal × (23/20) × (23/20)

Amount = 2000 × (529/400) = 5 × 529 = 2645.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2645.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate (R) = 15% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)T

 
• 
 
 
 
 +15% (₹300) +15% (₹345) Start (Year 0) ₹2000 Year 1 ₹2300 Year 2 ₹2645 Compound Interest Timeline 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 2000 × (1 + 15/100)²

⇒ A = 2000 × (115/100)²

⇒ A = 2000 × (23/20) × (23/20)

⇒ A = 2000 × (529/400)

⇒ A = 5 × 529

⇒ A = 2645

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2645.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Compound Interest Rate

For 2 years at rate R%, the effective compound interest percentage can be calculated directly using the successive percentage formula: Effective Rate = R + R + (R×R)/100.

SI vs CI Difference (2 Years)

The difference between compound interest and simple interest for exactly 2 years on a given principal is calculated by: D = P(R/100)².

Half-Yearly Compounding

If the compound interest is calculated half-yearly, the applied rate is halved (R/2) and the number of compounding time periods is doubled (2T).
